sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 4 April 2025, pitch SYN-SYNCP000068-P1 was put before Keystone Community Health 068 on behalf of MERCK & COMPANY.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 3 rebate of 5 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a HPV preferred-position minimum of 70 per cent in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer came back with a counter.
